markdown"><div style="position:relative"><header><h1>NVIDIA NIM</h1></header>
<p>The NVIDIA provider connects promptfoo to <a href="https://build.nvidia.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="">NVIDIA's hosted inference API</a> at <code>https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1</code>. The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so any model NVIDIA exposes through it can be used the same way you'd use OpenAI Chat Completions.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_tleR" id="setup">Setup<a href="#setup" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Setup" title="Direct link to Setup" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<p>Set your API key as an environment variable:</p>

<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_tleR" id="getting-an-api-key">Getting an API key<a href="#getting-an-api-key" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Getting an API key" title="Direct link to Getting an API key" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<ol>
<li class="">Sign in at <a href="https://build.nvidia.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="">build.nvidia.com</a> (free developer account).</li>
<li class="">Open any model card (for example, <a href="https://build.nvidia.com/meta/llama-3_3-70b-instruct" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="">Llama 3.3 70B Instruct</a>).</li>
<li class="">Click <strong>Get API Key</strong>. The key starts with <code>nvapi-</code>.</li>
</ol>
<p>NVIDIA's developer program currently grants a recurring allowance of free request credits per account, which is usually enough for prompt iteration and small evals before any paid usage is needed. Current credit limits and pricing are documented at <a href="https://build.nvidia.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="">build.nvidia.com</a>; check there for what is in effect today rather than assuming the value listed in any blog post.</p>

Set both <code>inputCost</code> and <code>outputCost</code> on the provider config if you want to record an estimate in eval output.</li>
<li class="">Tool calling and JSON-mode responses follow the same configuration as the <a class="" href="/docs/providers/openai/">OpenAI provider</a> because the API surface is OpenAI-compatible. Streaming responses are not implemented by this provider.</li>
<li class="">This provider supports NIM chat-completion models. Retrieval, embedding, reranking, and other NIM APIs require a provider that targets their corresponding endpoint.</li>
